name: cache_subset
purpose: Precomputed experiment results for the CPU-only mode (no GPU needed)
granularity: Answer texts, scores, and voting details (not full generations)
note: All results were produced by the same code version. headline values are 3-seed means; curves and other files use seed 0. unified.json is a 30-problem sub-experiment (weak vs. strong verifier) for directional reference only. In curves.json, keys are model names only (GSM8K entries share keys with MATH-500 entries), so filter by the dataset field when reading.
